title: Location sentences
focus: Use learned -ssa/-ssä forms in short written location statements.

exercises.prompt: Choose “The book is in the library.”
exercises.explanation: Kirja on kirjastossa. means “The book is in the library”. The subject is plural or supplied, on agrees with it, and kirjastossa gives the supplied place or state.

Correct. Kirja on kirjastossa. means “The book is in the library”. The subject is plural or supplied, on agrees with it, and kirjastossa gives the supplied place or state.
Use subject–verb–place order. Kirja on kirjastossa. means “The book is in the library”. The subject is plural or supplied, on agrees with it, and kirjastossa gives the supplied place or state.

exercises.misconceptionCategory: Inessive location sentences: form not yet correct

sentenceExplanation.translation: The book is in the library.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: Subject (who or what) + olla verb + place or state

parts.role: Subject — names who or what the sentence is about.
parts.formation: Kirja is supplied unchanged.

parts.role: Verb — connects the subject to its place or state.
parts.formation: on is the supplied written form of olla for this subject.

parts.role: Place or state — completes the idea.
parts.formation: Start with kirjasto and attach the learned inessive ending to form kirjastossa.
